items.title: PvP Pros
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Reveal your fighting spirit with these outfits made for PvP Pros.

+ 12 skins

items.title: Pixel Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs have been digitized and are glitching out! Take a look at these skins from different angles to see the crazy pixelated effect!

- 8 pixel skins!

This set include the following mobs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Zombie
- Spider
- Skeleton
- Bee
- Pig
- Slime

items.title: Trend Setters
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
You are the trend setter! Set the scene with your fashionable outfit, the rest will follow soon...

- 8 Trendy skin!
- Free skin: James
- Fashion, Stylish & Modern!

By CubeCraft

items.title: Steampunk Teens
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Take your futuristic items with you but stay in the past. Everything is old-fashioned but what if it got mixed up with the future?

+ 10 Steampunk skins
+ Free skin: Lance
+ Future, Fashion & Special!

By FTB

items.title: Faces of the Devil
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Sometimes the devil likes to play around and have some fun! Stand out and look different. See what fits you best! What devil face are you going to show today?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins
+ Fancy, demon attire inspired by charming devils!

items.title: Demon Slayer
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
There are demons to slay, people to save, and power to behold! Become the hero of your story, or embrace the evil within!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Fancy, demonic attire inspired by fantasy stories!

items.title: Eye Candy
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Sometimes sweet things come with style! Pick your favorite sweet and look your best at time same time! Be the eye candy!

+ 12 roleplay skins!
+ Sweet and fun attire inspired by candy!

items.title: Hacker Base II
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
A new base for all hackers! These overpowered tools and armor are finally among us! Knock your enemies back into oblivion! One shot the wither boss and ender dragon with a single arrow! Hacker Base II has all the tools you'll want and more!

- Hacked weapons!
- Hacked tools!
- Hacked armor!
- Awesome base!

items.title: Skyblock Parkour II
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour! A new life of parkour and survival awaits! Travel to the top and see what's in store for you! Do your best for a perfect parkour run!

items.title: Surreal Skyblock Chapter 3
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Explore the third world in the realms of "Surreal Skyblock" in chapter three! This time you are forced to stay on an island that is a single cube only. Limited resources make survival hard in this world. Are you able to beat the next level?

- Cubistic world
- Difficult Survival
- By Bumblesaurus

items.title: Cozy Sweaters
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
When the weather gets cold, it's time to bundle up! Dress the best in an adorable cozy sweater, and be prepared for any chilly day that comes your way!

- 8 Cozy Skins!
- Perfect for any winter day
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: GYEONGBOKGUNG PALACE
items.creator: Sandbox Network
items.description:
Welcome to Minecraft's Gyeongbokgung, one of the finest castles in Korea's Joseon Dynasty.
Located in Seoul Korea, here you can find replicates of actual buildings and various ornaments themed for the Lunar New Year season.
Start your journey now to explore the remarkable atmosphere and the adventure that awaits!

items.title: Animal Trend Fashion
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Join these amazing animals dressed in the latest fashion trends!

- 12 Skins
- 1 Free Skin
- By UnderBlocks

items.title: Glow Teens 2
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Glow teens are back and ready for action! Select your favorite from a variety of colors and shine your way through the crowd. Whether you like a certain color or just want something fun, this pack will brighten up your game.

items.title: Cryptic Mobs
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Cryptic Mobs are here! These mobs are corrupted! Check out these awesome neon style outfits!

- Trendy
- Glowing
- Roleplay

- By KA Studios

items.title: Floating Raft Survival
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Imagine flying in your private jet when the engine blows, you're descending fast and need a quick plan. Using balloons and the emergency flotation device, you stop the plunge to your death. It's now your mission to survive the skies. Beware, if you fall, you will surely die.

*Includes 8 skins
*Upgraded Raft Survival tools, now with automation
*27 custom items added

items.title: Nether Gods
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Become a Nether God!

Straight from the Nether... Choose any of these epic fire skins for your next adventure!

items.title: LUCKY BLOCK SUPER HEROES!
items.creator: Doctor Benx
items.description:
Have you always wanted to be a superhero? Now you can take on the role of 5 legends. Compete in an epic battle against 8 unique boss mobs or up to 4 friends!

- 29 items with HACKER enchantments
- 100+ Lucky Block drops
- 45 new craftable weapons + armor
- Spin the WHEEL OF FORTUNE for rewards
- Infinite world

By oectway + Benx
items.changelog:
- Updated to the latest Minecraft version
- Fixed all known bugs

items.title: Teens Life
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
Explore a city full of life and minigames. Role-play life of a teen at school, at the beach, diner or go shopping in the mall. Drive around the city with different vehicles like a bike, e-scooter, cars or just take the school bus for fast travel. 

- 9 UNIQUE MINIGAMES
- 72 OUTFIT COMBINATIONS
- 11 VEHICLES
- 16 SKINS (2 free)
- HIGH SCHOOL, CINEMA, BOWLING, BEACH, CITY

items.title: Sky Quest
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The world has been separated by an undead army, people are in need of a hero to save them from the chaos! Speak with people around the island and complete a journey filled with quests, puzzles, and battles to save the world from danger and discover its roots! Will you be their hero on this adventure?

- Puzzles and Quests
- Custom textures
- Custom map
- By inPixel

items.title: Animal Party
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Jump up and down! 
Party in the house! 
Dress up in your favourite animal, with these amazing animal onesie skins.

items.title: Lucky Blocks!
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
Lucky Blocks are here!
Break open a classic lucky block and test your luck. 
Will you get diamonds, a creeper or a prison cell? 
An epic experience for multiplayer or singleplayer.

items.title: Plane Crash
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description:
You have crash landed on a deserted island. Make use of the jungle around you, for onboard your plane were toxic rabbits that now roam the island with you. 
Survive and thrive in this great new adventure.

items.title: Snow Base
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Are you bored of the same old base maps? Well look no further. Get this winter themed snow base! Perfect to hide from your friends and conduct secret missions. This base is complete with farms, an armoury, chest storage and a helicopter!
